title: Bitcoin Miner Bitdeer Hits 273.5 MW AI Capacity With Malaysia Deal

tickers.name: Bitdeer Technologies Group Class A Ordinary Shares

summary:
A new 10 year lease for a 67 MW data center campus in Malaysia allows Bitdeer to house Nvidia GB300 systems. This expansion increases the total secured AI cloud capacity of the firm to 273.5 MW and pushes its active business pipeline beyond $10 billion.

The agreement, which spans a decade, marks a continued pivot for the Bitcoin miner into high performance computing infrastructure. The new Malaysian facilities are part of a broader strategy to leverage power and land assets for the AI cloud market.
